development_provenance: Known Batches 1-3 and earlier candidate audits already inspected; no independent unseen evaluation. No attempt to force known batches apart.
panels: primary5, morphology3, extended8, and three primary5-plus-one ablations; equal weights within a panel, not the frozen production consequence weights
reference_contract: Retain all measurable Batch 3 morphology, including known long-void sites. No ordinary-only replacement. Bright-only eligibility excludes observed low contrast; shared cross-phase comparisons also exclude observed grey-pore flags. Unknown quality, nonfinite measurements, insufficient component/pair coverage abstain.
component_coverage: At least 20 nonclipped >=50px2 bright components for aspect and 20 nonclipped aspect>=1.5 components for axial strength; K pair coverage rules remain unchanged.
measurement: Fresh raw BSE replay of five primary summaries plus aspect/alignment at paired thresholds -5/0/+5, using current trim/smooth/opening conventions. Reuse K's hash-bound phase association tables, with fresh signed-pair replay on four prespecified examples at all three thresholds. Nominal 100px2 floor changes only new aspect/alignment definitions, not primary features or raster association.
radiometric_controls: On those four raw BSE examples only: gamma 0.75, gamma 1.25, and rounded nonclipping affine 0.8I+20; rerun adaptive thresholds and new summaries on copies. Show changed observability/quality and numeric movement, never infer physical origin from invariance. Source eligibility for paired movement is explicit; new low-contrast cases are unavailable for a deployable comparison.
axis_control: Global 90-degree axis interchange negates K's x-y contrast; shape and axial strength remain invariant. Query-only interchange tests an unsupported section-orientation shift, not a material change. Fresh raw transpose checks on all four examples at nominal thresholds.
batch_model: Energy statistic 2 mean cross-distance minus within-reference and within-batch distances, including zero diagonals. Each allocation fits reference median and 1.4826 MAD; reference SD fallback, then unit fallback disclosed. Canonical content order ignores site names. Nonfinite rows/unknown quality are not imputed.
alert_policies: Audit primary5 alone, extended8 alone, and Holm-controlled union of primary5/morphology3 omnibus p-values. Also show unadjusted OR as a diagnostic. Univariate eight-KPI Holm tests explain location shifts only; they are not extra independent alert triggers. This does not calibrate the entire frozen production QC pipeline.
uncertainty: 4000 site-bootstrap raw-unit median-difference intervals. Incoming and reference deletion sensitivity redoes scaling/test; n<5 folds report unavailable alert status and numeric sensitivity separately. Specimen independence remains unknown.
reference_splits: Enumerate all disjoint n=5 and n=7 pseudo-incoming allocations within the full shared-eligible reference, fit scales per complement and use the exact allocation null. Report alert and abstention counts separately. These internal ranks have calibration by construction; overlapping splits are not independent trials or an external false-alert estimate.
iid_null: 200 independent draws each at 13-reference/5-incoming and 13-reference/7-incoming. Eight correlated Gaussian feature coordinates: 0.25 common + 0.25 block-specific + 0.5 independent variance (blocks primary5/candidates3). Fixed Monte Carlo allocations, all reference-dependent fits repeated. Wilson interval only for independent simulation draws.
feature_space_controls: 120 independent draws at 13-reference/7-incoming for each fixed scenario: one candidate shifted by +/-2 generating-population MAD (1.0 in Gaussian units), candidate spread doubled, and all five primary coordinates shifted by +2. These abstract summaries test engineering sensitivity, not physical material defects or manufacturing detection accuracy. Report paired detection gains with bootstrap-over-independent-draw intervals.
site_score: Mean distance to 3 nearest reference sites in reference-fitted standardized panel space, plus per-feature contributions at the nearest reference site. Reference sites scored whole-site LOO, queries against full reference; query median across reference-LOO fits is a matched-count sensitivity. LOO ranks are descriptive, not conformal p-values, calibrated membership probabilities or forced in/out labels. A separate Claude categoriser owns three-class identification.
acquisition_control: Whole-site LOO Ridge alpha=1, fold-local median imputation/scaling, six acquisition covariates: bright_sep,bse_p1,bse_std,bse_empty_bin_frac,etd_boundary_sharpness,H. Geometry/loading controls: current primary5 plus bright_d90,bright_circ,bright_count_per_Mpx. Both target-specific eligible and within-batch screens; poor prediction does not establish invariance or incremental novelty.
recommendation_gates: A candidate may go to versioned shadow OOD development when usable counts >=5, every threshold/floor mode has median absolute movement <=0.5 reference MAD and max <=2 MAD, no unresolved axis change, no radiometric valid-case movement >2 MAD, acquisition LOO R2<=0.25, and a candidate-shift control has paired mean detection gain >=0.10 with interval lower>0 over primary5. High geometry/loading R2>0.75 flags redundancy for review. These are engineering gates, not manufacturing tolerances. All gates and abstentions reported, never tuned after outputs. Automatic promotion is deferred if gates fail or are unmeasured.
model_gate: Holm-union IID false-alert Wilson interval must include 0.05 and upper<=0.10 at both sample sizes; a lower-than-0.05 interval indicates conservative/power-limited behaviour to disclose, not invalid calibration. Reference split outputs are internal checks, not proof of production calibration. No new live verdict input is activated by this audit.
outputs: Joined site/mode tables, source/raw hashes and registration, batch tests, eight-KPI comparisons, reference split and IID diagnostics, controlled detection gains, site distances/contributions, perturbation/axis tables, acquisition/redundancy controls, per-candidate recommendation, illustrated HTML, verifier, registry/log handoff. Preserve original caches and prior measurements.
limits: No held-back or new batch read; no defect or battery-performance labels; no specimen/session metadata; unreviewed masks; conditional site exchangeability. Promotion and a new release freeze are separate logged actions.
